uart.signal: Part-specific Cortex-M33 ELF programs UARTE20 EasyDMA TX registers and sends NRF54L10_OK; labwired test asserts the actual UART banner, memory banner, and GPIO P2.09 edges. Moving UARTE20 to a wrong address yields a precise BusFault and no banner (nRF54L05 negative control).
uart.lane: local labwired test --script examples/nrf54l05-l10/nrf54l10-smoke.yaml (4/4 on 2026-11-13); committed fixture appears in scripts/ci/docs-runnable-chips.json
uart.note: Synthetic board wiring only; no actual Nordic SDK, physical board UART, or full silicon parity.
